旺人。

    經營理念：

2) Quality control of raw materials                                                  2) 原物料品質管控
In addition to having a complete raw material inspection mechanism and               原物料採購方面，強化企業自主經營管
continuous monitoring of quality until the finished product is traced, the           理，除擁有完善的原物料進廠檢測機制，
Company’s management of raw material procurement also covers the                     並持續監控品質直至成品追溯，主要通過
following two aspects.                                                               兩種方式進行。


     上游供應商源頭管理：集團持續對原輔料供應商進行上游供應商源頭品質管理，集中建立了可食原料的《原材料調查
     表》，對其上游原料供應商，製作工藝，原料成分及添加比例等各方面進行監控，同時不定期針對供應商所用原料進
     行訪廠檢測，從源頭降低品質風險，目前原料產地都做到可追溯。
     Source management of upstream suppliers: The Group continued to conduct the source quality management of
     upstream suppliers towards raw materials suppliers, established the “Materials Survey Form” for edible raw materials,
     and monitored its upstream raw material suppliers, production processes, ingredients and proportions. Meanwhile, we
     randomly visit the factories for the raw materials used by the suppliers and reduce the quality risks from the source.
     At present, the origins of raw materials are traceable.


     進口原料備案制度：公司建立嚴格的進口原料備案制度，進口工廠嚴格按要求通過備案系統填寫境外生產企業和出口
     商或者代理商、境內進口商和購貨者等信息的進口和銷售記錄，強化追溯體系。
     Imported raw material filing system: The Company establishes a strict imported material filing system. The import
     factories are strictly required to fill in the information of overseas production enterprises and exporters or agents,
     domestic importers and purchasers, and the import and sales records through the filing system to strengthen the
     traceability system.

CHAIRMAN AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER                                             主席及行政總裁
Code provision A.2.1 provides that the roles of chairman and chief executive     根據守則條文第A.2.1條，主席與行政總裁
should be separate and should not be performed by the same person. Our           的角色應予區分，不應由一人同時兼任。
Company deviates from this provision because Mr. Tsai Eng-Meng performs          由於蔡衍明先生擔任主席兼行政總裁兩個
both the roles of chairman and chief executive. Mr. Tsai is the founder of       職務，故本公司偏離此條文。蔡先生為本
our Group and has over 40 years of experience in the food and beverages          集團之創辦人，於食品及飲料行業方面擁
industry. Given the current stage of development of our Group, the Board         有逾 40 年經驗。考慮到本集團目前之發展
believes that vesting the two roles in the same person provides our Company      階段，董事會認為，由一人同時兼任主席
with strong and consistent leadership and facilitates the implementation and     與行政總裁，在實施並執行本集團的業務
execution of our Group’s business strategies. We shall nevertheless review       策略時，可為本公司提供強大而貫徹之領
the structure from time to time in light of the prevailing circumstances.        導。然而，本集團將根據屆時情況不時檢
                                                                                 討現行架構。

Risk Management and Internal Control                                                  風險管理及內部監控
Risk Management and Internal Control Systems of the Group:                            集團風險管理及內部監控系統：
The Board acknowledges that it is responsible for establishing and                    董事會承認其須對建立及維持風險管理及
maintaining the Group’s risk management and internal control systems and              內部監控系統負責，並有責任確保該等制
for ensuring their effectiveness. Such systems are designed to manage                 度的有效性。該等系統旨在管理而非消除

   2.3   Subsidiaries                                                               2.3   附屬公司

   2.3.1 Consolidation                                                              2.3.1 合併賬目

   A subsidiary is an entity (including a structured entity) over which the         附屬公司指本集團擁有控制權的所
   group has control. The Group controls an entity when the Group is                有主體（包括結構化主體）。當本集
   exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns from its involvement with         團因參與該主體的營運而承擔可變
   the entity and has the ability to affect those returns through its power         回報的風險或享有可變回報的權益
   over the entity. Subsidiaries are consolidated from the date on which            並有能力透過其對該主體的權力影
   control is transferred to the Group. They are deconsolidated from the            響 此 等 回 報 時， 本 集 團 即 控 制 該 主
   date that control ceases.                                                        體。 附 屬 公 司 在 控 制 權 轉 移 至 本 集
                                                                                    團 之 日 起 合 併 入 賬。 附 屬 公 司 在 控
                                                                                    制權終止之日起停止合併入賬。

   Inter-company transactions, balances, income and expenses on                     集 團 內 公 司 之 間 的 交 易、 交 易 的 結
   transactions between group companies are eliminated. Profits and                 餘、 收 入 及 開 支 予 以 對 銷。 來 自 集
   losses resulting from inter-company transactions that are recognised             團內公司間的利潤和損失（確認於資
   in assets are also eliminated unless the transaction provides evidence           產）亦予以對銷，除非交易提供轉讓
   of an impairment of the transferred asset. Accounting policies                   資 產 減 值 證 據 則 另 作 別 論。 附 屬 公
   of subsidiaries have been changed where necessary to ensure                      司 的 會 計 政 策 已 按 需 要 作 出 改 變，
   consistency with the policies adopted by the Group.                              以確保與本集團採用的政策保持一
                                                                                    致。

   (a)   Business combinations                                                      (a)   業務合併

   The Group applies the acquisition method to account for business                 本集團採用購買法將業務合併入
   combinations. The consideration transferred for the acquisition of a             賬。 購 買 附 屬 公 司 的 轉 讓 對 價 為 本
   subsidiary is the fair values of the assets transferred, the liabilities         集 團 所 轉 讓 資 產、 對 被 收 購 方 前 擁
   incurred to the former owners of the acquiree and the equity interests           有人所產生負債及所發行股權的公
   issued by the Group. The consideration transferred includes the fair             平 值。 轉 讓 對 價 包 括 或 有 對 價 安 排
   value of any asset or liability resulting from a contingent consideration        產 生 的 任 何 資 產 或 負 債 的 公 平 值。

   2.18 Borrowings                                                                     2.18 借款

   incurred. Borrowings are subsequently stated at amortised cost; any                 用 為 初 始 確 認。 借 款 其 後 按 攤 銷 成

   or all of the facility will be drawn down. In this case, the fee is deferred        用 確 認 為 貸 款 的 交 易 費 用。 在 此 情
   until the draw-down occurs. To the extent there is no evidence that it              況 下， 費 用 遞 延 至 貸 款 提 取 為 止。
   is probable that some or all of the facility will be drawn down, the fee is         如沒有證據證明部份或全部融資將
   capitalised as a prepayment for liquidity services and amortised over               會 很 可 能 被 提 取， 則 該 費 用 資 本 化
   the period of the facility to which it relates.                                     作 為 流 動 資 金 服 務 的 預 付 款， 並 按
                                                                                       有關的融資期間攤銷。

   an unconditional right to defer settlement of the liability for at least 12         延至資產負債表日後最少12個月，否則
   months after the balance sheet date.                                                借款分類為流動負債。

     In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group may                 為 了 維 持 或 調 整 資 本 結 構， 本 集 團

                                                                                         出售資產以減低債務。

     Consistent with others in the industry, the Group monitors capital on the           與 業 內 其 他 公 司 一 樣， 本 集 團 利 用
     basis of the net gearing ratio. This ratio is calculated as total borrowings        淨 權 益 負 債 比 率 監 察 其 資 本。 此 比
     net of cash and cash equivalents divided by total equity excluding non-             率按已扣除現金及現金等價物的總
     controlling interests.                                                              借 款 除 以 總 權 益（ 不 含 非 控 制 性 權
                                                                                         益）計算。

     3.3   Fair value estimation (continued)                                              3.3   公平值估計（續）

     (a)   Financial instruments in Level 1                                               (a)   第 1 層金融工具

     The fair value of financial instruments traded in active markets is based            在活躍市場買賣的金融工具的公平
     on quoted market prices at the balance sheet date. A market is regarded              值根據資產負債表日的市場報價列
     as active if quoted prices are readily and regularly available from an               賬。 當 報 價 可 即 時 和 定 期 從 證 券 交
     exchange, and the price represents actual and regularly occurring                    易 所 獲 得， 而 該 報 價 代 表 按 公 平 交
     market transactions on an arm’s length basis. The quoted market price                易基準進行的實際和常規市場交易
     used for financial assets held by the Group is the current bid price.                時， 該 市 場 被 視 為 活 躍。 本 集 團 持
     These instruments are included in level 1.                                           有的金融資產的市場報價為當時買
                                                                                          方報價。此等工具包括在第 1 層。

     (b)   Financial instruments in Level 2                                               (b)   第 2 層金融工具

     The fair value of financial instruments that are not traded in an active             並非於活躍市場上進行買賣的金融
     market is determined by using valuation techniques. These valuation                  工 具 的 公 平 值 利 用 估 值 技 術 釐 定。
     techniques maximise the use of observable market data where it is                    估值技術儘量利用可觀察市場數據
     available and rely as little as possible on entity specific estimates, if all        （如有），儘量少依賴主體的特定估
     significant inputs required to fair value an instrument are observable,              計。 如 計 算 一 金 融 工 具 的 公 平 值 所
     the instrument is included in level 2.                                               需 的 所 有 重 大 輸 入 為 可 觀 察 數 據，
                                                                                          則該金融工具列入第 2 層。

     Specific valuation technique used to value financial instruments is                  特定估值技術用了評估金融工具為
     quoted market price.                                                                 市場價格。
